papers.title: Spin‐Valence Reconstruction Enabled by a Gradient Heterointerface for Reversible Protonic Ceramic Oxygen Electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Efficient and durable oxygen electrodes are essential for reversible protonic ceramic cells (R‐PCCs), yet reconciling proton transport, oxygen redox kinetics, and transition‐metal electronic states remains challenging. Here, we report a gradient heterointerface strategy that drives Ba redistribution in Pr 0.5 Ba 0.5 Co 0.7 Fe 0.3 O 3‐δ (PBCF), forming a chemically graded PBCF/PBCFvac/BaSnO 3 (PBCF‐BS) interface that couples structural and spin‐valence reconstruction. Beyond conventional defect or secondary‐phase engineering, the gradient heterointerface couples coordination reconstruction with counter‐directed Co/Fe valence redistribution, favoring spin‐active Fe 3+– O–Co 4+ configurations and strengthening mixed‐valence exchange within the Co─Fe─O network. This interfacial spin‐valence coupling introduces an electronic degree of freedom beyond vacancy regulation, reorganizing Co/Fe 3d–O 2p hybridization and metal–oxygen covalency to accelerate oxygen activation and reversible oxygen redox kinetics. Consequently, the PBCF‐BS oxygen electrode exhibits high reversible electrocatalytic activity, delivering a peak power density of 2.4 W cm −2 at 700°C in fuel‐cell mode and an electrolysis current density of 4.08 A cm −2 at 1.3 V and 650°C under 10 vol.% H 2 O, together with robust operational stability under steam‐rich conditions. This work establishes a spin‐electronic regulation paradigm through gradient interfacial reconstruction and provides a mechanistic framework for designing advanced reversible protonic ceramic oxygen electrodes.
papers.summary_ko: 가역적 양성자 세라믹 셀(R-PCC)의 산소 전극 성능 향상을 위해 Pr0.5Ba0.5Co0.7Fe0.3O3-δ(PBCF)에 Ba 재분배를 유도하는 구배형 PBCF/PBCFvac/BaSnO3 헤테로계면을 도입했다. 이 계면은 구조적 재구성과 스핀-원자가 재구성을 동시에 유발하여 Co/Fe 3d-O 2p 혼성화와 금속-산소 공유성을 조절함으로써 산소 활성화와 가역적 산소 환원·산화 반응 속도를 가속화한다. 그 결과 700°C에서 2.4 W/cm²의 피크 전력밀도, 650°C·1.3V·10% H2O 조건에서 4.08 A/cm²의 전해 전류밀도와 수증기 환경에서의 안정적 구동을 달성했다.

papers.title: Nitrogen‐Rich Covalent Organic Frameworks Enable Reversible Lithium Deposition in Anode‐Free Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Poor lithium reversibility and sluggish interfacial kinetics limit the areal capacity and rate capability of anode‐free lithium batteries. A nitrogen‐rich covalent organic framework (COF) as an interphase layer promotes uniform lithium deposition, enabling plating/stripping at 20 mAh/cm 2 in Li/Cu cells and anode‐free full‐cell operation at 4.1 mAh/cm 2, as reported by Z. Ouyang, S. Zheng, S. Li, et al., Angewandte Chemie Novit 2 (2026): e70027.
papers.summary_ko: 질소가 풍부한 공유결합성 유기 골격체(COF)를 계면층으로 도입하여 무음극(anode-free) 리튬 배터리에서 리튬의 불균일한 증착과 낮은 가역성 문제를 해결했다. 이 COF 계면층은 균일한 리튬 증착을 유도하여 Li/Cu 셀에서 20 mAh/cm²의 도금/탈리 용량과 무음극 완전셀에서 4.1 mAh/cm²의 작동을 구현했다.

papers.title: Mechanochemical Coordination of Coupled Defect Repair for Upcycling Degraded Ni‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Direct conversion of spent polycrystalline Ni‐rich layered cathodes into single‐crystal counterparts has emerged as an important route toward high‐value resource circularity. However, mechanical treatment, although necessary for particle homogenization, can couple with pre‐existing chemical defects and push degraded cathodes from reparable degradation into irreversible damage by inducing bond rupture and structural disorder. To address this issue, a defect‐guided upcycling strategy of defect repair before recrystallization is proposed. A high‐temperature prelithiation step first heals Li vacancies, regulates transition metal migration, and reconstructs the distorted local Li─O/TM─O coordination environment, thereby restoring lattice order and relieving stress concentration. Subsequent mechanical homogenization and single‐crystal reconstruction enable the transformation of degraded polycrystalline particles into structurally uniform single‐crystal particles. Multiphysics simulations and experimental characterizations reveal that this strategy effectively suppresses ball‐milling‐induced local bond fracture, secondary cracking, and cation disorder, lowers the barrier for structural recovery, and promotes ordered lattice reconstruction. The regenerated single‐crystal Ni‐rich cathode delivers an initial specific capacity of 181.96 mAh g −1 and a capacity retention of 87.34% after 100 cycles. This work establishes a new defect‐regulation framework for the direct high‐value upcycling of spent Ni‐rich layered cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 폐기된 다결정 Ni-rich 층상 캐소드를 단결정으로 직접 전환하는 업사이클링 공정에서, 기계적 처리와 기존 화학적 결함이 결합해 비가역적 손상을 유발하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 재결정화 전 결함 복구 전략을 제안했다. 고온 예비리튬화로 Li 공공과 전이금속 이동을 먼저 치유한 뒤 기계적 균질화와 단결정 재구성을 수행하여, 재생된 Ni-rich 캐소드가 181.96 mAh/g의 초기 용량과 100회 사이클 후 87.34%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Interface Engineering to Unlock Multi‐Electron S n+ /S 2− Redox Reaction and High Lithium Anode Utilization
papers.abstract_en: All‐solid‐state lithium–sulfur batteries (ASSLSBs) offer high theoretical energy density, yet their practical viability is impeded by sluggish cathodic redox kinetics and uncontrolled anodic dendrite growth. Here, we address these challenges by a dual‐interface engineering strategy that exploits halogen anion migration to in situ construct phase‐separated localized electrochemical microreactors (LEMRs) at both electrodes. At the cathode, an in situ‐formed Li 6 PS 5 Cl/LiCl/Li 2 S‐LiI internal LEMR activates the S 2− /S n+ (n ≥1) multi‐electron redox reaction beyond the conventional S 2− /S 0 redox reaction while maintaining structural integrity. Concurrently, at the Li anode, an interfacial LiCl/C@LiI/LiCl‐LiI anode LEMR confines Li plating/stripping within the LEMR to suppress lithium dendrites. This dual‐LEMR architecture enables the optimized cells to deliver a capacity retention of 86.3% after 450 cycles at 3.6 mAh cm −2 and 80% after 70 cycles at a high areal capacity of 7.5 mAh cm −2 under a low N/P ratio of 0.78, and to achieve an ultra‐high areal capacity of 32.8 mAh cm −2. This work highlights the potential of anion chemistry as an effective interface engineering strategy to overcome the kinetics and stability limits of all‐solid‐state lithium batteries, and provides a versatile framework for advancing high‐energy ASSLSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬-황 배터리에서 양극의 느린 환원·산화 반응 속도와 음극의 덴드라이트 성장 문제를 동시에 해결하기 위해, 할로겐 음이온 이동을 이용한 양극·음극 이중 계면 공학(LEMR) 전략을 제시했다. 양극에서는 Li6PS5Cl/LiCl/Li2S-LiI 계면이 S2-/Sn+ 다전자 환원·산화 반응을 활성화하고, 음극에서는 LiCl/C@LiI/LiCl-LiI 계면이 리튬 도금·탈리를 국소화하여 덴드라이트를 억제한다. 이를 통해 낮은 N/P 비(0.78)에서도 7.5 mAh/cm²의 높은 면적용량과 450사이클 후 86.3%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Ferroelectric‐Field Gating Suppresses the Outward Migration of Active Oxygen Intermediates in Li‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Li‐rich layered oxides deliver high capacities through cation–anion co‐redox chemistry. During high‐voltage charging, however, peroxide/superoxide‐like O─O intermediates migrate down their concentration gradient from oxygen‐redox‐active regions toward particle surfaces, accumulating at the interface. This accumulation accelerates irreversible O 2 evolution and structural degradation, leading to low initial Coulombic efficiency and rapid capacity fading. Here, we construct a spontaneously polarized ferroelectric LiNbO 3 interfacial layer that generates a built‐in electric field to regulate oxygen redox in Li‐rich cathodes. This electric field suppresses concentration‐gradient‐driven migration and interfacial enrichment of charged active oxygen intermediates, limiting O 2 evolution and preserving a uniform surface‐to‐bulk distribution of oxygen electronic states at high delithiation. Consequently, the optimized cathode delivers 310 mAh g −1, an initial Coulombic efficiency of 99.97%, and 79% capacity retention after 500 cycles. Furthermore, this strategy enables Li‐metal pouch cells to achieve an energy density of 620 Wh kg −1 and graphite‐based pouch cells to maintain stable operation over 2000 cycles. This work establishes ferroelectric‐field regulation as an effective strategy for stabilizing oxygen redox chemistry in Li‐rich cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Li-rich 층상 산화물 캐소드에서 고전압 충전 시 생성되는 과산화물/초산화물 유사 O-O 중간체가 입자 표면으로 이동·축적되어 비가역적 O2 발생과 구조 붕괴를 유발하는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 강유전성 LiNbO3 계면층을 도입하여 내부 전기장으로 산소 중간체의 이동을 억제했다. 이를 통해 310 mAh/g의 용량, 99.97%의 초기 쿨롱 효율, 500사이클 후 79%의 용량 유지율을 달성했으며, 리튬 금속 파우치셀에서 620 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도를 구현했다.

papers.title: Distinguishing Symptoms From Etiology: A Cascading Degradation Mechanism in Cobalt‐Free Layered Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Cobalt‐free layered cathodes are pivotal for next‐generation lithium‐ion batteries due to their cost‐effectiveness, high energy density, and sustainability. However, the complex interplay between severe structural disorder and intrinsic degradation factors remains elusive, hindering their rational design and practical application. Herein, this study reveals a “cascading degradation mechanism” that decouples initial disorder from dynamic deterioration, identifying intrinsic oxygen vacancies as the fundamental “etiology” while distinguishing accumulated cation disorder as a “symptom.” Leveraging multi‐scale characterization on model LiNi 0.6 Mn 0.4 O 2 and Density Functional Theory calculations, the results demonstrate that intrinsic oxygen vacancies trigger a triple synergistic effect of aggravated lattice distortion, high‐voltage oxygen loss, and accelerated interfacial side reactions, which kinetically facilitates Ni migration, driving irreversible structural degradation. Consequently, this work establishes the Li/Ni disorder accumulation (ΔLi/Ni) in limited cycles as a dynamic indicator for evaluating long‐term stability. Based on this mechanism, the optimized NM‐880 cathode delivers excellent long‐term stability, achieving a 92.37% capacity retention after 400 cycles at 0.5 C. The universality of this indicator is robustly validated in commercial LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 and LiNi 0.5 Co 0.2 Mn 0.3 O 2 systems. This work signals a paradigm shift in cathode design: moving from optimizing static initial structures to regulating defect‐induced dynamic evolution.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트가 없는 층상 캐소드의 열화 기구를 "원인(산소 공공)"과 "증상(양이온 무질서)"으로 구분하는 연쇄적 열화 모델을 제시했다. 다중 스케일 분석과 DFT 계산을 통해 내재된 산소 공공이 격자 왜곡, 고전압 산소 손실, 계면 부반응을 유발해 Ni 이동과 비가역적 구조 붕괴를 가속한다는 것을 규명했으며, 이를 바탕으로 최적화된 NM-880 캐소드가 0.5C에서 400사이클 후 92.37%의 용량 유지율을 달성했고 상용 NCM622, NCM523 계에서도 지표의 범용성을 검증했다.

papers.title: Covalent–Ionic Bonding Regulation Enables Chemo‐Mechanical Stabilization of High‐Voltage O3‐Type Sodium Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Ni–Fe–Mn‐based O3‐type layered oxides are attractive cathode materials for sodium‐ion batteries, but their high‐voltage operation suffers from the coupling between phase transitions and lattice oxygen instability. In this work, guided by hard and soft acids and bases (HSAB) theory, we propose a covalent–ionic dual‐pathway decoupling strategy to stabilize high‐voltage O3‐type layered cathodes. The incorporation of Mg, Ti, and F constructs a rigid architecture in which a covalent Ti─O framework reinforces the transition‐metal octahedral skeleton to suppress detrimental phase transitions, while localized Mg─F ionic coordination stabilizes lattice oxygen through localized electrostatic anchoring to mitigate irreversible oxygen release. Through multiscale structural and spectroscopic analyses, we verify that this bonding regulation suppresses the O3→P3→OP2 multiphase evolution and lattice oxygen escape. The modified cathode maintains 76.32% capacity retention over 400 cycles at 1 C and exhibits robust cyclability across −10°C to 50°C; the assembled full cells achieve a reversible capacity of 166.27 mAh g −1 with an energy density of 330.22 Wh kg −1 at 0.1 C, and an initial capacity of 143.74 mAh g −1 with 72.06% retention after 500 cycles at 1 C. This work demonstrates a bonding‐regulation paradigm that decouples chemo‐mechanical degradation in high‐energy‐density layered oxide cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지용 Ni-Fe-Mn 기반 O3형 층상 산화물 캐소드의 고전압 안정성을 높이기 위해 HSAB 이론에 기반한 공유-이온 결합 이중 경로 전략을 제안했다. Mg, Ti, F를 도입해 Ti-O 공유 골격이 전이금속 팔면체를 보강하고 Mg-F 이온 결합이 격자 산소를 정전기적으로 고정함으로써 O3→P3→OP2 상전이와 산소 방출을 억제했다. 개질된 캐소드는 1C에서 400사이클 후 76.32%의 용량 유지율을 보였고, 완전셀에서 330.22 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: An Expandable Library of Solid Polymer Electrolytes for Lithium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Solid‐polymer‐electrolytes (SPEs) offer alternatives to next‐generation solid‐state lithium‐metal batteries, promising advantages in mechanical‐compliance, processability, cost‐effectiveness, and safety. While tremendous efforts have generated diverse SPEs since 1970s, SPE‐practicality remains limited by the trade‐offs among ion‐conductivity, high‐voltage stability, and Li 0 ‐electrolyte compatibility. Here, we establish the first SPE library covering 12 SPEs across five polymer families, which allows us to collect large datasets on chemistry, interfacial, and electrochemical properties that unveil their hidden connections. Correlation analysis of these descriptors reveals binding‐strength between polymer and Li +, subtle variations in polymer molecular structure, and solid‐electrolyte‐interphase composition as dictating factors. Also discovered is that the standard deviation of coulombic‐efficiency rather than its average value governs the battery cycling stability. The SPE library can be rapidly expanded through two structural engineering pathways: grafting diverse functional segments onto backbones and constructing compositionally‐complex SPEs. As a proof‐of‐concept, we fabricate several such SPEs and find improved high‐voltage stability through gradually increasing the complexity of the polymer matrices. A terpolymer‐based acrylates SPE exhibits outstanding Li 0 plating/stripping over 1800 h, stable cycling in LiCoO 2 ||Li battery with 100% capacity retention and an average coulombic‐efficiency of 99.91% ± 0.09% over 100 cycles. This work provides a transformative framework to design the future polymer materials.
papers.summary_ko: 차세대 전고체 리튬금속전지용 고체 고분자 전해질(SPE)의 설계 규칙을 밝히기 위해 5개 고분자 계열, 12종의 SPE로 구성된 최초의 라이브러리를 구축하고 화학적·계면적·전기화학적 데이터셋을 상관분석했다. 고분자-Li+ 결합 강도와 쿨롱 효율의 표준편차(평균값이 아님)가 사이클 안정성을 좌우하는 핵심 변수임을 발견했으며, 작용기 그래프팅과 조성 복잡화를 통해 라이브러리를 확장할 수 있음을 증명하고 삼원공중합체 아크릴레이트 SPE로 Li 도금·탈리 1800시간 이상, LiCoO2||Li 셀에서 100사이클 간 100% 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Spatial Confinement Enables In Situ Growth of the Nano-Sn@Sn3(PO4)2 Anode for Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Nanoarchitecturing improves capacity utilization and mitigates mechanical stress of Sn anodes for elevated energy density sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), yet substantial surface energy induces nanoparticle aggregation. Traditional heterotopic coatings cannot sustain long-term mechanical confinement upon repeated volume variation of Sn. Herein, we propose a dealloying-induced phase transformation and spatial confinement strategy to in situ construct a robust Sn3(PO4)2 coating on Sn nanoparticles. Sn3(PO4)2 provides spatial confinement for the homogeneously dispersed Sn nanoparticles, while the nano-Sn (∼20 nm) within the Sn3(PO4)2 framework effectively alleviates mechanical stress and suppresses volume expansion. Consequently, Sn@Sn3(PO4)2 exhibits attractive structural integrity and electrochemical performance, with a reversible capacity of 772 mAh g–1, 83% capacity retention after 3600 cycles, and 583 mAh g–1 at 5 A g–1. Moreover, the Sn@Sn3(PO4)2||Na3V2(PO4)3 full cell delivers a favorable cycling stability and rate performance. This in situ reconstruction strategy guides electrode surface engineering and facilitates the application of Sn-based anodes in future SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지용 Sn 음극의 나노입자 응집 문제를 해결하기 위해 탈합금화 유도 상전환과 공간 가둠 전략으로 Sn 나노입자(~20nm) 표면에 Sn3(PO4)2 코팅을 in situ 형성했다. 이 Sn3(PO4)2 골격이 부피 변화에 따른 기계적 응력을 완화하여 772 mAh/g의 가역 용량과 3600사이클 후 83%의 용량 유지율, 5 A/g에서 583 mAh/g의 속도 성능을 달성했으며 Na3V2(PO4)3와의 완전셀에서도 우수한 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Photocatalytic PVDF Degradation Coupled With Catalytic Targeted Li Replenishment Toward Low‐Energy Repair of Spent LiFePO 4 Electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Directly repair is recognized as a promising route for recycling spent lithium iron phosphate (LFP), but it is challenged by uneven Li supplementation and high energy input. Herein, we propose a photocatalytic strategy for PVDF degradation coupled with targeted Li replenishment toward low‐energy repair of spent LFP materials. Supported by theoretical analysis and in‐situ characterizations, TiO 2 can generate photogenerated electron–hole pairs synchronously under UV irradiation. The photogenerated holes promote the formation of •OH radicals, which abstract hydrogen atoms from the methylene units in PVDF, triggering the scission of polymer backbones and thus enabling the effective degradation of PVDF. Meanwhile, the photogenerated electrons accumulated on TiO 2 create a strong reductive microenvironment conducive to the reduction of Fe 3+ to Fe 2+, which reduces the Li + migration barrier and facilitates lithium replenishment. The TiO 2 catalyst can incorporate into the material lattice as a favorable dopant to optimize the performances of as‐repaired LFP material. Specially, the repaired LFP material with 2.5 mol% TiO 2 delivers a high discharge capacity of 140.6 mAh g −1 at 1 C with 99.8% capacity retention ratio after 100 cycles. Even at a high rate of 5 C, it maintains 98.3% capacity retention ratio over 1500 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiFePO4(LFP) 전극의 저에너지 복원을 위해 광촉매 PVDF 분해와 표적 리튬 보충을 결합한 전략을 제안했다. UV 조사 시 TiO2가 생성하는 정공은 •OH 라디칼을 통해 PVDF를 분해하고, 전자는 Fe3+를 Fe2+로 환원시켜 Li+ 이동 장벽을 낮춤으로써 리튬 보충을 촉진한다. TiO2 2.5 mol% 도핑으로 복원된 LFP는 1C에서 140.6 mAh/g, 100사이클 후 99.8%의 용량 유지율을, 5C·1500사이클에서도 98.3%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Novel Fluorinated Amino‐Ester Electrolyte With Host–Guest Solvation Enables High‐Voltage and Thermally Safe Lithium–Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium–metal batteries (LMBs) face critical bottlenecks to high energy density, long cycle life, and thermal safety, mainly due to insufficient oxidation stability and thermal tolerance of solvation structures in conventional carbonate/ether electrolytes. In this work, we develop a host–guest solvation structure via a molecular fluorination strategy based on a tertiary amine‐ester scaffold functionalized with trifluoroethyl (CF 3 CH 2 ─) and hexafluoroisopropyl ((CF 3) 2 CH─) groups, affording two fluorinated solvents: N, N‐dimethylcarbamate trifluoroethyl (TFE) and N,N‐dimethylcarbamate hexafluoroisopropyl (HFS). The distinct polarity contrast between TFE and HFS delivers functional complementarity: TFE, with strong Lewis basicity, promotes lithium‐salt dissociation, while highly fluorinated HFS, with weak solvation ability, accelerates interfacial reduction kinetics through a delocalized charge‐transfer mechanism, forming a LiF/Li 2 O‐rich nanocrystalline solid electrolyte interphase. Consequently, in Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 configurations, the as‐designed electrolyte enables a 10 Ah pouch cell to stably cycle over 260 cycles with 95.2% capacity retention, and a 4.5 V‐charged 22.4 Ah pouch cell delivers an initial energy density of 550 Wh kg −1. The pouch cell also survives nail penetration and exhibits significantly delayed thermal runaway. This amino‐ester molecular design offers key insights for developing high‐energy, safe LMBs toward practical industrial applications.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬금속전지의 고전압 안정성과 열 안전성을 동시에 확보하기 위해 삼차 아민-에스터 골격에 트리플루오로에틸(TFE)과 헥사플루오로이소프로필(HFS) 기를 도입한 호스트-게스트 용매화 구조의 불소화 전해질을 개발했다. 강한 루이스 염기성의 TFE는 리튬염 해리를 촉진하고 약한 용매화력의 HFS는 LiF/Li2O가 풍부한 SEI 형성을 가속하여, Li||NCM811 10Ah 파우치셀이 260사이클 이상 95.2%의 용량 유지율을 보였고 4.5V 22.4Ah 파우치셀은 550 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도와 못 관통 시험 통과, 열폭주 지연을 달성했다.

papers.title: Hydroxyl‐Orchestrated Crystallization and Affinity Sites in Covalent Organic Framework Membranes for One‐Step Selective Ternary Ion Separation
papers.abstract_en: One‐step selective separation of multiple coexisting ions from complex aqueous media remains a formidable challenge. Here we report hydroxyl‐orchestrated covalent organic framework (COF) membranes that couple framework crystallization with hydrazone‐carbonyl pocket‐site formation, enabling ternary separation of Cs +, Sr 2+ and UO 2 2+ in a single step. Hydroxyl substitution decelerates interfacial polymerization while reinforcing intralayer hydrogen bonding to stabilize ordered frameworks, yielding high crystallinity. Concurrently, hydroxyl‐orchestrated enol‐imine to keto‐enamine tautomerization promotes the formation of hydrazone‐carbonyl pocket sites for selective UO 2 2+ chelation. The optimized membrane achieves a UO2 2+ uptake of 336 mg g −1 and a Cs + permeation flux of 0.26 mol m −2 h −1, while exhibiting suppressed Sr 2+ permeation. Under ternary conditions, Cs + /Sr 2+ and Cs + /UO 2 2+ separation factors reach 81.5 and 326.9, with stable performance over repeated cycles. These findings establish hydroxyl‐orchestrated crystallization and pocket‐site engineering as a powerful approach for multi‐component ion separations.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 매질에서 Cs+, Sr2+, UO2 2+을 한 단계로 선택적으로 분리하기 위해 수산기로 결정화와 친화 자리를 조절한 공유결합성 유기골격체(COF) 분리막을 개발했다. 수산기 치환이 계면 중합을 늦추고 수소결합을 강화해 높은 결정성을 얻는 동시에 엔올-이민에서 케토-엔아민으로의 토토머화를 유도해 UO2 2+에 선택적인 히드라존-카르보닐 포켓을 형성한다. 이 분리막은 UO2 2+ 흡착량 336 mg/g, Cs+/Sr2+ 및 Cs+/UO2 2+ 분리 인자 각각 81.5와 326.9를 달성했다.

papers.title: Anion‐Anchoring, Anti‐Swelling Polymer Interphase Enables Durable Lithium Metal Anodes in Localized High‐Concentration Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: Localized high‐concentration electrolytes (LHCEs) can improve the cycling stability of lithium metal batteries by promoting anion‐rich solvation structures that favor the formation of inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphases (SEIs). However, their favorable interfacial chemistry is not self‐sustaining because the native SEI is heterogeneous and prone to repeated rupture during Li plating/stripping, thus progressively depleting active Li and electrolyte. Polymeric artificial SEIs have emerged as a complementary strategy for interfacial stabilization, but their effectiveness in LHCEs is limited by an inherent conflict: the polar functional groups that coordinate ions also coordinate solvents, causing polymer swelling, dissolution, and disruption of anion‐rich solvation structures. Here, we develop an anion‐anchoring and anti‐swelling artificial SEI (AS–SEI) by integrating imidazolium cations with long aliphatic side chains. Imidazolium cations enable anion anchoring to sustain the LHCE‐favored anion‐rich environment at the interface, while long aliphatic chains provide anti‐swelling behavior that protects anchoring sites from competitive solvation. Consequently, AS‐SEI exhibits a high Young's modulus (5.0–10.5 GPa) and a high Li + transference number (0.94), while promoting the formation of LiF/Li 2 O‐rich SEIs. Li||Cu cells achieve 480 cycles with 99.5% average Coulombic efficiency, while Li||NCM811 cells deliver ∼900 cycles with 80% capacity retention (a nearly threefold improvement), with the strategy remaining effective across ether‐, ester‐, and sulfone‐based LHCEs.
papers.summary_ko: 국소 고농도 전해질(LHCE)에서 리튬금속 음극의 SEI가 반복적으로 파괴되어 활성 리튬이 소모되는 문제를 해결하기 위해 이미다졸륨 양이온과 긴 지방족 측쇄를 결합한 음이온-고정·팽윤방지 인공 SEI(AS-SEI)를 개발했다. 이미다졸륨이 음이온을 고정해 음이온이 풍부한 계면 환경을 유지시키고 긴 측쇄가 팽윤을 방지하여 5.0-10.5 GPa의 높은 영률과 0.94의 Li+ 이동수를 구현했다. Li||Cu 셀은 99.5% 평균 쿨롱 효율로 480사이클, Li||NCM811 셀은 80% 용량 유지율로 약 900사이클을 달성해 기존 대비 거의 3배 개선되었다.
